name: Reachability Destination
description: The destination role of the reachability compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): an Amazon Inspector v2 network-reachability finding, the middle node -> the EC2 network interface its port range is open on, the last network-interface step of networkPath.steps. The interface, not the instance: an instance can have several, and it is one ATTACHED_TO_INSTANCE away. The finding retires with this end (COMPOUND_EDGE retires_with). Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/inspector.py (aws-core-tap#261).
